title: Relics of Seirai
description: You rescue a woman named Fujiwara Toshiko on Seirai Island. She seems to be searching for a family heirloom here...

mainQuestExcel.title: Relics of Seirai
mainQuestExcel.description: You rescue a woman named Fujiwara Toshiko on Seirai Island. She seems to be searching for a family heirloom here...

flow.stepDescription: Rescue the person surrounded by monsters

dialogs.text: Th—Thank you... Phew, to think that these guys would try to catch me unaware like that...
Who are you?
I'm Fujiwara Toshiko, and I'm here to... Um...
Never mind. Since you did save me, I might as well tell you.
I'm actually here to find treasure that my ancestors left behind here!
T—Treasure...!
And have you found it?
Hahaha, of course I have. I've followed some clues to the treasure's location, and I've ascertained my method of entry.
But just as I was about to activate the switch and enter the area where the treasure is stored, those monsters sneaked up and attacked me.
I owe you my life for chasing those monsters away. Thank you.
Um, so, could I...
Could I ask you to protect me for a while longer?
I still have to find that treasure, but I don't think I'll be able to handle all these monsters alone...
I'll... I'll even share some of the treasure with you!
Is there really treasure here?
I'm sure I can find that treasure! Just trust me!
I've even found the switch that'll allow us to enter the place where the treasure is hidden. It's just over there.
That said, the mechanism doesn't seem to be something we can open directly. It requires some special method to activate...
I have a map left by my ancestors here with me, and it contains clues as to how I might figure this mechanism out...
But... Heh, I still haven't figured it out yet.
Here, why don't you have a look as well? For all I know, you might be able to figure something out.
*sigh* But really, how am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
Can you really find it?
What are you doing here?
How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
Wh—What was that noise...
Did you just see that? A giant... hole just opened up over there!
Looks like there's... some sort of basement here! Let's go in and have a look, come on!
This mechanism seems to be of the same kind as the one that we unlocked on the way in.
Just, you know... more complicated...
But it's fine, right? I'm sure the ancestral map I've got has some clues for us!
How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...
How am I supposed to solve this puzzle...

flow.stepDescription: Wait for Fujiwara Toshiko to open the chest

dialogs.text: Why's there only this inside...
What happened?
Other than this picture, there's nothing in this chest.
Is this the treasure? That's so odd.
*sigh* I don't think we can split this, can we...
Well, how about this, then? Let's head back to my camp first.
I'll provide you with the payment once we get back there.
Right, then. Let's go.
Only one picture? How strange...

flow.stepDescription: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp
Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogs.text: Eh? What is it this time...
Struck it rich, did you?
Y—You...
Hehe. Come on now, cut it with the nonsense. Give it up, or else! We're not leaving empty-handed...
What? Wait a moment! All I found was this picture!
A picture? Well, we'll take that too! Come on lads, get 'er!
H—Help me, Traveler, please!
Just when did we catch the eye of those Treasure Hoarders...
Thank you, Traveler, let's head back to camp.

flow.stepDescription: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp
Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogs.text: Wh—What is going on...
Please halt.
Could we bother you to leave the treasure you found with us?
What...
Did you not just fight those Treasure Hoarders off to protect the treasure you found?
It stands to reason, then, that it must be something very valuable.
I thought I said that it was just one picture!
It seems we are at an impasse, then. But we shall not be denied, not after following those Treasure Hoarders for all this time. Attack!
H—Hey, listen to me, will you!? Traveler! Help!
These people aren't listening to me at all! I said it already, we only found one picture!
Let's go. We need to get back to my campsite...

flow.stepDescription: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp
Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogs.text: Ohh, what now!?
Hand that picture over.
The Fatui!? Wh—What are they doing here!?
It's just your ordinary, normal, run-of-the-mill picture! If you want it, just take it, alright?
Is there anything else? Hand those over too!
Anything else? There's nothing else! I really only found this one picture!
Hmph! Why would one crummy picture be hidden by so many complex mechanisms?
If we hadn't trailed those samurai, we wouldn't have found this basement at all.
We're not leaving empty-handed after so much waiting. Get them!
I... I really... Traveler, please, help me!
Wh—Why doesn't anyone believe that this picture is all I found? I mean...
You've got to at least let your victim tell you what they've got while you're robbing them, right?
Let's just go...
*whimpers* A—Alright... Let's just get back to camp. I've had enough of this...

flow.stepDescription: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp
Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogs.text: Meow!
Agh! Wh—Who is it this time! Please, I just found this one picture, that's all I found, honest!
I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'll never go looking for treasure ever again!
It's just a cat...
Eh? Is it? Oh...

flow.stepDescription: Follow Fujiwara Toshiko to the camp

dialogs.text: Phew, we're back at last. Hold on for a moment while I get your payment ready.
That should do it. This isn't much, but please accept it.
This treasure hunt sure turned out to be a mess — and all that for a single picture.
Why would my ancestors set up so many mechanisms just to protect one picture?
I don't get it at all. Maybe I should bring this picture back to Inazuma City and ask around a bit...
Hmm, maybe I should go ask Mr. Oda Tarou...
